resources.string: Put both earbuds in your ears first, then tap Start. The test checks how well they seal.
Testing… keep both earbuds in your ears
Put both earbuds in your ears
Make sure the earbuds are in your ears. Adjust the left earbud until it sits snugly, then test again.
Make sure the earbuds are in your ears. Adjust the right earbud until it sits snugly, then test again.
Make sure the earbuds are in your ears. Adjust both earbuds until they sit snugly, then test again.
